name: Thaumaturgy (Rituals) — 2 Intermediate — A Touch of Nightshade

system.description: After anointing his hands with deadly nightshade extract, the thaumaturge poisons anyone he touches with bare skin until sunrise, inflicting one unhalved health level of bashing damage per hour to Kindred and lethal damage to mortals. The poison cannot be reversed by the caster, resists medical treatment or blood-burning, and does not transfer if the victim's blood is drunk.
